build_grasp_model: build a ResNet-based grasp sampler model with IfullRobHWNet for robot grasping angle and noise prediction
create_ifullrobhw_net: create an IfullRobHWNet instance with pretrained ResNet18 weights and configurable hidden layer size
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on IfullRobHWNet with image input, robot labels, height, width, and full image
review_one_forward: review the _one_forward method that extracts features through conv layers and average pooling
test_pretrained_loading: test the load_from_pretrained_resnet18 method to load pretrained ResNet18 weights from model zoo
